description.value:
The thin, glittering strands of rope that comprise this thick belt appear to be spun gold. Strung along the front of the belt are a collection of four multicolored, perfectly spherical beads: jade, turquoise, quartz, and amethyst. While wearing the lash, you gain a +3 item bonus to Religion.

When you invest the belt, you either increase your Wisdom modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Sage's Lash (Turquoise)]

Activate—Jewel of the Mind 2 (concentrate, manipulate) You touch one of the jewels affixed to the sage's lash and think the associated command word. Depending on the jewel, a different effect is produced that affects you and all living creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. After the effect occurs, all four jewels disappear from the lash, reappearing at the next dawn.

  • Amethyst (light, revelation) Think "verity" to emit a magical trail of light from the lash that reveals the location of each creature in the emanation. For 1 round, if they would be invisible, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed] instead, and if they would be undetected or unnoticed by a creature, they're hidden instead. A creature can attempt a @Check[stealth|dc:43] check to avoid the lash's detection.

  • Jade (healing) Think "purity" to produce a wave of green light that ends any sickened condition and any persistent poison damage affecting creatures in the emanation.

  • Quartz (healing, vitality) Think "lenity" to have each creature regain @Damage[30[healing]] Hit Points.

  • Turquoise Think "clarity" to grant all affected creatures a +2 status bonus to their next Will save for 1 minute. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Sage's Lash (Turquoise)]
